build_isaac_processor: build an IsaacProcessor instance with an IsaacImageProcessor and HfTokenizer for multimodal text-image input
create_isaac_image_processor: create an IsaacImageProcessor with configurable patch_size, max_num_patches, and pixel_shuffle_scale
process_vision_for_patches: process vision tensors by resizing, normalizing, and patchifying RGB images for the vision encoder
patchify_vision: patchify normalized vision tensors into flattened ViT-style patches of a given patch_size
apply_chat_template: apply a chat template to mixed text-image messages by replacing image content with vision tokens
